description: Read what is currently written on a whiteboard: the text of its sticky notes and shapes, grouped by frame, as a plain-text outline. This is the CURRENT contents of a live collaborative canvas that people may still be editing -- not a finished document, and not a history of what the board used to say. Only text comes through: drawings, arrows, and images have nothing to extract, so a busy-looking board can honestly come back sparse. When note_count is 0, say the board has no readable text rather than guessing at what is drawn on it. Find a board's id with list_whiteboards. Very large boards are cut off; `truncated` tells you when.
name: read_whiteboard
